metadata.title: Credit Card Authorization Form - Performance Supply Depot LLC
metadata.description: Secure authorization to keep credit card on file for purchases and recurring orders. A PDF copy will be emailed upon submission.

settings.confirmationMessage: Thank you! Your authorization has been submitted. A PDF copy will be emailed to you and Performance Supply Depot within 5 minutes.

items.title: Section 3 — Credit Card Information
items.description: The card to be kept on file

validation.message: Please enter a valid 15 or 16 digit credit card number (numbers only)

items.title: CVV / Security Code
items.helpText: 3 digits (back of card) or 4 digits (front of AmEx)

items.title: Billing ZIP Code (Credit Card)
items.helpText: 5-digit ZIP on file with your bank

options.value: I hereby authorize Performance Supply Depot LLC to charge the credit card listed above for purchases, invoices, or recurring orders made by my business. I confirm that I am an authorized user of this credit card and that I will not dispute charges provided they correspond to the terms indicated on invoices or order confirmations.

I authorize Performance Supply Depot LLC to store this credit card information securely on file for future transactions, recurring orders, or replacement orders requested by my business. This authorization will remain in effect until I provide written notice to revoke it.

I understand that a PDF copy of this authorization, including the information I have provided, will be generated and emailed to both myself and Performance Supply Depot LLC for record-keeping purposes.

items.title: Electronic Signature (Type Your Full Name)
items.helpText: By typing your full name, you agree this constitutes a legal electronic signature

items.helpText: You may cover all but the last 4 digits for security
